## At or above NAEP Proficient

Percentage of students in each SES group performing at or above the *NAEP Proficient* achievement level.
Districts are sorted by the Low SES percentage.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Grade 4 Mathematics

```{r}
ses_dotplot("Mathematics", 4, "proficient")
```

```{r}

```
